source: FEATURE-20261119-trig-long-range-bridge-sub3 (D14241, D14257, D14284-D14286). 341640 Triglavian Conduit Core = clone of Organic Mortar Applicators 2870 without a group change (group 1041 Advanced Commodities - Tier 4, category 43; SDE 3396210 typeDogma record present). Not 48121 Triglavian Survey Database: it has no typeDogma record, so the client tool would refuse it (D700). Not a fuel: group 1041 is not 1136 Fuel Block, so the structure fuel bay never takes it (D14257, W132); the Living New Eden mod consumes it on Cargo Deposit to an Ansiblex. iconID 21982 = res:/UI/Texture/Icons/Inventory/triglavianSurveyData.png (SDE icons). 341641 blueprint = clone of Spatial Attunement Unit Blueprint 33196 (group 447, category 9, D693/D700). Manufacturing: 200 Zero-Point Condensate 48112, 400 Crystalline Isogen-10 47975, 50 Triglavian Survey Database 48121 (Abyssal loot, all tiers); 259200 s; skill 3400 level 1 and max runs 2 as the Ansiblex blueprint 36961; copying 720000 s = 36961 (SDE 3396210 blueprints.jsonl); no research. 341642 is reserved (V2 look). Client: re-run ApplyClientData.

overrides.name: Triglavian Conduit Core
overrides.description: Conduit core built from Triglavian technology recovered in Abyssal Deadspace. Deposit it into your alliance's Ansiblex with Cargo Deposit: the Living New Eden mod uses up the core and makes that Ansiblex a Triglavian long-range bridge. It is not fuel.

overrides.name: Triglavian Conduit Core Blueprint
overrides.description: Blueprint of the Triglavian Conduit Core: 200 Zero-Point Condensate, 400 Crystalline Isogen-10 and 50 Triglavian Survey Database (Abyssal Deadspace loot), 3 days, the skill of the Ansiblex Jump Bridge Blueprint at level I. Maximum 2 runs per copy. See the item description.
